title: Patient Research In Self-Management of Asthma (PRISMA)
brief_summary: The objective of this study was to investigate if a nurse-led telemonitoring programme is effective and cost-effective in asthmatic outpatients, aged seven years and older.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 7 years or older
* Asthma severity of stage I - III as described in the GINA guidelines
* Must be competent to use an asthma monitor
* Must possess a household phone connection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Respiratory co-morbidity
